title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll build, refine, and deploy machine learning models to support predictive analytics, customer insights, and operational optimization.
* You'll explore and analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities for business impact.
* You'll apply statistical and algorithmic techniques, including data mining and visualization, to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
* You'll develop scalable data workflows in close collaboration with data engineering teams, working effectively with remote colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* You'll collate, clean, and transform data from multiple sources to create robust, well\-structured datasets for analysis and modelling.
* You'll support feature engineering and exploratory data analysis (EDA) activities to prepare data for machine learning and advanced analytics initiatives.
* You'll fluently query, manage, and optimize SQL databases and data files to support analytical and business requirements.
* You'll work effectively within a globally distributed team, proactively communicating progress, challenges, and outcomes across time zones.
* You'll translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product, business, and leadership stakeholders across multiple locations.
* You'll produce accessible, non\-technical reports and presentations that communicate both the value and limitations of analytical work.
* You'll contribute to best practices in experimentation, model governance, feature development, and data science methodologies.
* You'll engage confidently with virtual collaboration tools and asynchronous ways of working to maintain strong team alignment and effectiveness.
* You'll stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, and adjacent fields to ensure outputs remain relevant, innovative, and impactful.
* You'll have experience applying Logistic Regression models to solve classification problems and generate actionable business insights.
* You'll have experience building and interpreting Decision Tree models to identify patterns, support decision\-making, and solve business challenges.
* You'll have experience designing and analysing experiments, including A/B testing, to evaluate outcomes and support data\-driven recommendations.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* You'll bring 3\+ years of industry experience in data science, advanced analytics, and/or machine learning.
* You'll have prior experience working in or alongside offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, which will be considered a strong advantage.
* You'll demonstrate strong proficiency in Python and/or R, including feature engineering, model training, ad hoc simulations, and reporting.
* You'll possess solid knowledge of common machine learning algorithms, such as Logistic Regression, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting, and Unsupervised Learning techniques.
* You'll apply working knowledge of Bayesian statistics, including concepts such as posterior updates and Bayesian networks.
* You'll confidently use SQL databases and structured data files to support analysis, modelling, and reporting activities.
* You'll have experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* You'll be familiar with code management and DevOps tools, including Git and Docker.
* You'll have experience deploying data science and machine learning solutions into production environments.
* You'll bring exposure to architecture design and cross\-functional collaboration with IT and engineering teams.
* You'll have experience with parallel computing frameworks such as Hadoop, Spark, or similar technologies.
* You'll be a self\-starter who takes ownership, works proactively, and delivers high\-quality results with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll communicate clearly and proactively, keeping remote stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged throughout projects.
* You'll be comfortable navigating ambiguity and working independently across different time zones and global teams.
* You'll be able to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business requirements, tailoring communication for diverse global audiences.
* You'll be collaborative, curious, and committed to continuous learning and professional development.
* You'll be enthusiastic about sharing knowledge and helping others grow, whether collaborating with colleagues locally or across the world.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

 We also offer some other perks including:
   

  

* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Company Overview:** 




  






 At Arya AI, we are revolutionizing the BFSI sector with our cutting\-edge enterprise AI solutions. Our platform empowers financial institutions to make smarter, faster, and more secure decisions using state\-of\-the\-art AI models for decisioning, document processing, fraud detection, and more.
 





 As pioneers in deep tech, we focus on delivering scalable, enterprise\-grade AI products that blend innovation with seamless user experiences. Our mission is to create intuitive, high\-performing interfaces that make AI adoption effortless and impactful for our clients, ranging from leading banks to fintech disruptors.
 




  






 Arya.ai’s team consists of highly experienced deep learning and machine learning researchers and data scientists. Since 2013, Arya.ai has worked with leading enterprises, such as banks, insurance companies, and financial service players, worldwide.
 




  





**Role Overview:** 




  






 As a Data Scientist, you will operate at the intersection of analytics, modeling, and enterprise\-grade deployment. You’ll translate business challenges into data\-driven solutions, build and iterate on robust ML models, and operationalize them to deliver measurable impact across financial services workflows.
 





 The ideal candidate combines strong statistical foundations, hands\-on engineering skills, business intuition, and the curiosity to work on emerging paradigms such as multi\-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval systems, and AI orchestration.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Build, improve, and optimize machine learning and deep learning systems.
* Own end\-to\-end model development and deployment, from data collection and pipeline creation to evaluation, validation, and production rollout.
* Design AI systems across multiple data types including text, tabular, image, and documents.
* Develop LLM\-powered applications using prompt pipelines, RAG, agentic workflows, and domain\-specific reasoning.
* Implement agentic AI patterns such as planning, tool use, orchestration, and autonomous decision support.
* Integrate AI systems with enterprise tools, APIs, and external platforms using MCP, function calling, and structured context frameworks.
* Build retrieval, reranking, and contextual memory pipelines to improve AI reliability and performance.
* Deploy AI systems in cloud and on\-premise environments with a focus on scalability, observability, security, and governance.
* Analyze model outputs and system performance to drive continuous improvement and business impact.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and leadership teams on execution, roadmap planning, and AI\-native product development.
* Work across internal product initiatives and client deployments, from feasibility analysis to production implementation.
* Maintain high standards in clean coding, experimentation, documentation, and reproducible ML workflows.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent.
* Exposure in machine learning, deep learning, statistics, and applied AI.
* 1\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying ML/DL systems in production.
* Good experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent.
* Comfortable working across text, tabular, categorical, image, and document\-heavy datasets.
* Familiarity with LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, and model evaluation.
* Understanding of agentic AI concepts such as planning, memory, orchestration, tool use, and multi\-agent systems.
* Exposure to MCP, tool\-calling architectures, API integrations, or similar enterprise AI integration patterns.
* Strong coding skills with clean, modular, and well\-documented practices.
* Strong understanding of validation, error analysis, monitoring, and production improvement cycles.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-evolving environments with shifting priorities.
* Strong ownership, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers, product teams, and leadership.


- 


  





**What You’ll get:** 



* A competitive and meaningful compensation package
* One of the best health care plans that not only covers you but also your family
* A great team to work, learn and thrive.
* Micro\-entrepreneurial tasks and responsibilities.
* Career development and leadership opportunities



  





**Why Us:** 




  






 Financial services face some of the most demanding, mission\-critical AI challenges—often underserved and unsolved. At Arya.ai, you’ll:
 



* Work directly with global financial institutions
* Pioneer first\-of\-its\-kind solutions in the industry
* Operate in a culture that values openness, innovation, and people




 If you want to push the boundaries of applied AI in real\-world, high\-stakes environments, Arya.ai is the place to build.

title: Senior Data Scientist|NR-2026-0241 (4)
description:
**Role : Senior Data Scientist** 




  





**About Media.net :** 




 Media.net is a leading global ad tech company, building innovative products and solutions for advertisers and publishers. Media.net creates the most transparent and efficient path for ad budgets to become publisher revenue, while delivering meaningful value to advertisers, publishers, app developers, and end users across the open web.
 



  





 We are one of the world’s largest independent contextual advertising businesses, with one of the industry’s most comprehensive advertising technology portfolios. Media.net powers major publishers and ad\-tech platforms across formats, including display, video, mobile, native, search, and local. Our platform manages high\-quality ad supply across 500,000\+ websites and is licensed by the biggest publishers, ad networks, and technology partners worldwide.
 



  





 Beyond our core advertising business, Media.net also operates at scale in performance\-driven consumer acquisition, app development and distribution, and strategic technology investments. These efforts are supported by one of the world’s largest independent software development engines, enabling us to innovate rapidly and build products used across global markets.
 



  





 Media.net is home to 1,300\+ employees, with key operations across North America, Europe, and Asia. Our US headquarters is in New York, and our global headquarters is in Dubai. Across 50\+ demand partners, 21K\+ publishers, and a growing portfolio of products and services, we take great pride in driving trusted, transparent, and scalable results.
 



  





 Data Science is at the heart of Media.net. The team uses advanced statistical and machine learning and deep learning models, large scale distributed computing along with tools from mathematics, economics, auction theory to build solutions that enable us to match users with relevant ads in the most optimal way thereby maximizing revenue for our customers and for Media.net.
 



  





 Some of the challenges the team deals with:
 


* How do you use information retrieval, machine learning models to estimate click through rate and revenue given the information regarding the position of the slot, user device, location and content of the page. How do you scale the same for thousands of domains, millions of urls?
* How do you match ads to page views considering contextual information? How do you design learning mechanisms to continuously learn from user feedback in the form of clicks and conversions? How do you deal with the extremely sparse data? What do you do for new ads and new pages? How do we design better explore\-exploit frameworks? How do you design learning algorithms that are fast and scalable?
* How do you combine contextual targeting with behavioral user\-based targeting?
* How do you establish a unique user identity based on multiple noisy signals so that behavioral targeting is accurate?
* Can you use NLP to find more genetic trends based on the content of the page and ads?



  





**What is in it for you?** 




  




* Understand business requirements, analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of historical data.
* Use your knowledge of Information retrieval, NLP, Machine Learning (including Deep Learning) to build prototype solutions keeping scale, speed and accuracy in mind.
* Work with engineering teams to implement the prototype. Work with engineers to design appropriate model performance metrics and create reports to track the same.
* Work with the engineering teams to identify areas of improvement, jointly develop research agenda and execute on the same using cutting edge algorithms and tools.
* You will need to understand a broad range of ML algorithms and appreciation on how to apply them to complex practical problems. You will also need to have enough theoretical background and a good grasp of algorithms to be able to critically evaluate existing ML algorithms and be creative when there is a need to go beyond textbook solutions.



  





**Who should apply for this role ?** 




  




* PhD/Research Degree or BS/MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine learning, Operations Research or related field.
* 6 years of experience in building Machine Learning/AI/Information Retrieval models
* Extensive knowledge and practical experience in machine learning, data mining, artificial intelligence, statistics.
* Understanding of supervised and unsupervised algorithms including but not limited to linear models, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting machines etc.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of scientific programming in Python.
* Experience with Apache Spark is desired.
* Excellent verbal \& written communication skills



**Bonus Points:** 



* Publications or presentation in recognized Machine Learning and Data Mining journals/conferences such as ICML
* Knowledge in several of the following: Math/math modeling, decision theory, fuzzy logic, Bayesian techniques, optimization techniques, statistical analysis of data, information retrieval, natural language processing, large scale data processing and data mining
* Ability deal with ambiguity \& break them down into research problems
* Strong theoretical and research acumen

title: Director - Data Science
description:

 NapChief is a fast\-growing D2C kidswear brand. We sell through our own website (napchief.com) and all major marketplaces including Myntra, FirstCry, and Amazon. At Nap Chief, we're redefining kids' wear for a new generation of parents. We craft premium, super\-soft clothing that kids love to wear and parents trust. Our mission is to empower the young generation and we are looking for you to join forces with us to conquer this mission. 
 



  





**About the role:** 




 You will own the website business end\-to\-end: revenue, profitability (CM2\), merchandising, conversion, retention, and the promotional calendar. Everything that determines whether napchief.com grows profitably sits with you. You operate it like your own store, working through a junior team and in partnership with the performance marketing lead.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 Revenue and P\&L ownership:
 


* Own monthly and quarterly website revenue targets and CM2 (contribution margin) targets. Build the revenue plan: traffic × conversion × AOV × repeat rate, and manage every lever in it.
* Report weekly on revenue performance, drivers, and corrective actions in the business review.



  





 Merchandising and launches:
 


* Own the site merchandising calendar: new collection drops, product launches, collection pages, bestseller placement, and catalog presentation.
* Plan launches for a seasonal kidswear line — winter\-weight and summer\-weight assortments, size runs, and gifting windows — jointly with the fashion buyer so demand plans are backed by inventory.
* Own pricing and offer architecture on the website: bundles, sets, first\-purchase offers, and price\-point strategy.



  





 Promotions and sale events:
 


* Own the full sale calendar: festive\-season events, end\-of\-season sales, and campaign\-led promotions.
* Design promotion mechanics (tiered offers, bundles, category\-level discounts) that deliver revenue spikes while protecting contribution margin — moving beyond blanket sitewide discounting.
* Run each event end\-to\-end: stock planning with the buyer, site preparation, communication plan across email/WhatsApp/ads, live monitoring, and post\-event P\&L review.



  





 Retention and CRM:
 


* Own the full repeat\-purchase system: email, WhatsApp, and SMS marketing — segmentation, campaign calendar, and automated flows (welcome, post\-purchase, replenishment/size\-up, winback, abandoned checkout).
* Own cohort retention and LTV: track repeat rates by cohort, diagnose drop\-offs, and build programs that bring customers back as their kids grow into the next size.
* Own the post\-purchase experience on the website side: order communication, review collection, and the "how did you hear about us" survey program.



  





 Conversion rate and AOV:
 


* Own funnel performance: landing pages, collection pages, PDPs, cart, and checkout. Run a continuous, prioritized testing program.
* Own AOV programs: bundling, upsells, cross\-sells, and free\-shipping thresholds.
* Own the Shopify tech stack: app selection, site speed, search and navigation, and theme\-level improvements (directing developers/tools as needed).



  





 Performance marketing partnership:
 


* Allocate acquisition budgets to the performance marketing manager based on the revenue plan; review return jointly every week. You are mutually accountable — their new\-customer numbers feed your revenue targets.



  





 Analytics and team:
 


* Maintain the website dashboard: conversion, AOV, repeat rate, cohorts, CM2 by category — the numbers leadership reviews weekly.
* Manage and develop the junior team (marketing executives and performance associates), setting their weekly plans and reviewing output.



  





 KPIs you own:
 


* Website revenue vs plan
* CM2 (contribution margin) on website business
* Conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchase rate / LTV
* Sale\-event revenue and margin outcomes



  





 Requirements:
 


* 5\-6 years in D2C with recent, hands\-on revenue ownership — you have grown a store's numbers yourself, with results you can quantify and defend. "Worked at a D2C brand" in a coordination or support role does not qualify.
* Fluency across the Shopify ecosystem: storefront, apps, analytics, and CRM/marketing tools (Klaviyo or equivalent email platform; WhatsApp marketing tools).
* Strong analytical grounding: cohort analysis, funnel metrics, unit economics, and margin math are daily working tools for you.
* Experience planning and running sale events with P\&L accountability.
* Experience getting work done through a junior team — this role is an enabler, not a solo contributor.
* Background in a growing brand or startup environment, where targets moved and you moved with them.

title: Business Solutions Specialist
description:
The Business Solutions Specialist plays a key role within Fleet IT's IT Operations \& Supply Chain function, helping the business make better decisions through clear reporting and smarter automation. Working primarily on the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps and Power Automate), the role turns business needs into practical, low\-code solutions \- with growing exposure to RPA and AI/GenAI capabilities as Anglo\-Eastern's automation landscape evolves. The focus throughout is on improving data visibility, decision\-making, efficiency, accuracy, compliance and scalability across the organization.
   

  

**Requirements**
**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
* Create clear, reliable reporting and dashboards \- primarily using Power BI, including data models (star schema) \- that give business stakeholders visibility into operational and financial performance
* Shape the data behind those reports using Power Query (M) and DAX, so numbers stay accurate, fast to load and consistent across the business
* Look after reports once they go live \- refresh schedules, workspace access and row\-level security (RLS) in Power BI Service \- so business users always see the right data, safely
* Turn manual, repetitive processes into simple, easy\-to\-use apps and forms \- using Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-driven), including the underlying logic and connectors that make them work
* Build and support automated workflows using Power Automate (Cloud and Desktop), with room to extend into RPA, AI Builder and Copilot as the platform \- and your skills \- grow
* Set up and maintain the data foundations behind these solutions \- Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules and security \- so everything stays reliable as it scales
* Follow good governance and change\-management practice \- moving solutions cleanly from development to testing to live, with the right approvals and data\-protection policies in place \- so everything stays safe, supportable and audit\-ready
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand what they need, and turn that into simple designs and documentation everyone can follow
* Be the go\-to person when something isn't working \- troubleshooting reporting, apps and automation issues, and escalating platform\-level problems when needed
* Keep learning as the automation and AI landscape evolves \- including RPA, GenAI and Agentic AI \- and bring ideas back to improve how the team works


**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**
**Technical Skills**
* Certifications: PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) is the primary certification for this role, with PL\-200 (Power Platform Functional Consultant) and PL\-400 (Power Platform Developer) as valuable additions
* Power BI (primary specialism): confident with data modelling (star schema), Power Query (M), DAX, row\-level security (RLS), performance tuning, and publishing through the Power BI Service with scheduled refresh
* Low\-code/no\-code: comfortable building end\-to\-end solutions with Power Apps (Canvas and Model\-driven) on SharePoint and Power Automate (Cloud and Desktop), including AI Builder and Copilot. General exposure to RPA concepts and tools is a plus
* Dataverse: a working understanding of table/relationship design, business rules, security roles and business process flows; exposure to plug\-ins/custom APIs is a bonus
* Automation governance: aware of good ALM practice \- solution\-based deployment, Dev/UAT/Prod environments, and environment variables/connection references
* Programming \& scripting: basic SQL; familiarity with Python or VBA for data handling is a bonus


**Professional Skills**
* Comfortable working independently across a project's full lifecycle, with a working knowledge of SDLC / Agile ways of working
* Good at documentation and business analysis \- able to translate what stakeholders need into clear, simple technical designs
* Curious about GenAI and Agentic AI \- a bonus, not a requirement
* Proactive, data\-led mindset with a focus on process improvement, data governance and solution scalability


**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**
* 3\-4 years of hands\-on experience building reporting, apps and automation solutions \- primarily on the Microsoft Power Platform \- with strong depth in Power BI
* Confident, hands\-on experience with Power Apps and Power Automate \- this is a core part of the role, not a nice\-to\-have
* Bachelor's degree (Any Graduate); a background in Computer Science, IT or a related field is an advantage
* PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification preferred; PL\-200 and PL\-400 certifications an advantage


**Benefits**
 About Anglo\-Eastern
   

  

 Anglo\-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.
   

  

 Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo\-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore\-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.
   

  

 Why join Anglo\-Eastern?
   

  

* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long\-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future

title: Senior Manager — Industry Domain (Credit Decisioning)
description:
Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI\-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000\+ users across 70\+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.
 



  





**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo** 




  





 Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technology. Our platform's human\-centric design, coupled with enterprise\-grade scalability and AI\-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.
 



  





**Recognition \& Trust** 




  





 ● Backed by $45M\+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.
 



 ● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!
 



 ● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.
 



 ● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a
 



 "Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.
 



 ● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Credit decisions at scale — whether a loan gets approved, at what rate, under what conditions — are governed by business rule engines and decision frameworks that have been refined over decades inside banks, NBFCs, and risk analytics firms. Vymo's agentic AI systems interact with, augment, and in some cases replace components of these decisioning frameworks.
 



  





 Building the right system requires someone who understands how business rule engines actually work: how rules are authored, versioned, tested, and deployed; how credit policy translates into decision logic; where the standard engines fall short and where manual override is still the norm. That is this role.
 



  





 You are the person who sits between a client's risk team and Vymo's product team — making sure that what is being built reflects how credit decisioning actually works in a regulated Indian financial institution, not how a software team imagines it works. You will carry domain knowledge from the BRE layer through to the underwriting policy and credit risk framework that sits above it.
 



  





***The crux of this role: you know enough about credit decisioning and BRE architecture to know which questions, asked in which sequence, reveal how a client's decision engine actually works — and what Vymo needs to build to sit alongside it or replace it.***




  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**1\. Client Discovery — Decode the Decision Engine** 



* Diagnose architectural realities and data flows by asking targeted questions that reveal system dependencies, latencies, and integration requirements.
* Translate discovered logic gaps into actionable visual maps and precise engineering specifications for the product team.



**2\. Product Requirements — Translate Decisioning Logic Into What to Build** 



* Translate credit decisioning and Business Rule Engine (BRE) logic into precise product specifications for Vymo's agentic layer, defining routing, rule execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop interventions.
* Validate technical assumptions against BFSI deployment cycles while mapping major BRE platforms (e.g., SAS, Experian, FICO) to ensure architectural accuracy.



**3\. GTM Support — Lend Credibility to the Technical Sales Conversation** 



* Partner with sales teams in high\-stakes sessions to provide deep architectural credibility and handle advanced technical inquiries regarding BRE and decisioning systems.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client architects and risk heads, auditing technical proposals and developing GTM assets that address platform constraints and regulatory governance.



**4\. Industry Intelligence — Track How Decisioning Is Evolving** 



* Track RBI regulatory changes—including the Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF) and AI explainability rules—alongside Indian BRE market trends to anticipate compliance demands.
* Build a strong network of industry experts to validate core architecture choices and feed real\-world market insights directly into the product roadmap.



  





**What You will Bring** 




  





**Experience \& Fluency** 




  




* **Domain Background:** 
 Operational depth in credit decisioning across key sectors—whether coming from BRE vendors (SAS, FICO, Experian), bank/NBFC credit risk teams, underwriting operations, risk consulting, or credit bureaus.
* **BRE \& Risk Architecture:** 
 Deep understanding of Business Rule Engine (BRE) architectures, rule authoring, champion\-challenger frameworks, scorecard calibration, and baseline risk concepts ($PD/LGD/EAD$).
* **Origination \& Integration Landscape: Practical knowledge of Loan Origination System (LOS) integration patterns, core platform configurations (e.g., PowerCurve, Blaze Advisor), and performance metrics like Straight Through Processing (STP) rates.**
* **Regulatory \& Compliance Context:** 
 Familiarity with RBI guidelines regarding algorithmic credit decisions, model risk management, explainability requirements, and cloud data localisation constraints.



  





**Mindset \& Core Traits** 




  




* **Architectural Inquiry:** 
 Driven by deep curiosity about how entire systems fit together, possessing the precise sequence of targeted questions that uncover how a client’s engine
 *actually* 
 operates beneath the documentation.
* **Skeptical Practitioner:** 
 Operates with a healthy skepticism of stated architectures; validates system realities by analyzing deployment logs, rule histories, and exception reports rather than relying solely on official diagrams.
* **Policy\-to\-Logic Translation:** 
 Seamlessly bridges the gap between high\-level credit policy language and structured, actionable rule engine engineering specifications.
* **Grounded Intellectual Humility:** 
 Explicitly understands the boundaries of personal technical knowledge, prioritizing accurate discovery and domain\-expert networking over making unverified assumptions.

title: Manager Founder's Office
description:
We are seeking a Manager Founder’s Office for a Series A funded Wellness Brand.
 



  





**Job Profile** 




 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



 Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



 Diagnose performance. Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



 Generate insights. Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



 Support important decisions. As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



 Build analytical systems. Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





**Manager Founder’s Office Requirements:** 




 Any Post Graduate
 



 5\-10 Years of experience
 



 Must have proven experience solving unusually difficult analytical problems
 



 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



 What we need:
 



 Analytical reasoning\- You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



 Data fluency\- You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



 Business judgment\- You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: “So what?”
 



 Intellectual independence\- You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



 Intellectual honesty\- You are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet” and equally comfortable saying “I was wrong.”
 



 Communication\- You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



 What This Role Is NOT
 



 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.

title: Risk Senior Specialist, AVP
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title\- Risk Senior Specialist, AVP**
**Location\- Mumbai, India**
**Role Description**
* Market Valuation and Risk Management (MVRM) is responsible for managing market risk and ensuring fair value assessment of Books \& Records within Deutsche Bank. The primary market risk objective is to ensure that business units of the bank optimize the risk\-reward relationship and do not expose it to unacceptable losses. We work closely with risk takers, risk managers and control and support groups in the process to ensure these objectives can be met.
* Market Data Strategy and Analytics (MDSA) is a function within MVRM that is responsible and accountable for the procurement, analysis and governance of historical market data used as inputs in the key risk metric (eg Value at Risk, Economic Capital, Credit Counterparty Risk, Portfolio Stress Test).


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
   

  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Applying experience and subject matter expertise to perform RTB tasks such as VaR/SVaR impact analysis for both Hist Sim Sensi Based and Hist Sim Full Reval, continuous improvement of processes and coordination of changes in market data.
* Perform data quality checks to ensure the completeness and accuracy of EOD data / time series are at par to use for risk calculations.
* Manage weekly market data releases within SLAs for VaR/SVaR/FRTB/Economic capital calculation and ensure timely escalation.
* Analyzing impacts of time\-series changes on group level VaR and ability to communicate/coordinate effectively to stakeholders.
* Liaising with Market risk managers, FO quant, change teams and Methodology to perform deep dives on data challenges in new market risk models/methodology changes/RNIV and implementation of new regulations such as FRTB and IHC examination.
* Actively take apart in proxy decision making and come up with appropriate proxy choices for a time\- series.
* Perform Stressed\-period\-selection and analyze results for accuracy and reliability.
* Help specify requirements and test functionality for new implementation and ability to coordinate with Risk\-IT and Strats for seamless implementation of new data requirements and process enhancements.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 5 to 8 years of experience in investment banking, Market Risk, specifically in controlled production environments.
* Good knowledge of financial instruments and understanding pricing of vanilla derivatives across all asset classes
* Strong understanding of global markets across asset classes and ability to connect macroeconomic events with impact to various market data points
* Demonstrated excellence in production activities for a financial institution with a strong control culture
* Experience of change management and implementation of new production processes
* Hands\-on experience of using external data sources such as – Bloomberg, MarkIT \& Reuters.
* Programming skills in Python is a must


**Education \| Certification (Recommended):**
* Engineering or bachelor’s degree in finance from an accredited college or university with excellent project experience and grades in quantitative and numerical coursework.
* Certification in Financial Risk Management will be a plus.


**Business Competencies:**
* Communication \- Experienced
* Industry Knowledge \- Experienced
* Risk Management – Basic
* Innovation – Basic
* Managing Complexity \- Basic


**Technical Competencies:**
* Risk Management – Experienced
* Financial Product Knowledge \- Experienced


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

**About Us And Our Teams**
 Please visit our company website for further information:
   

  

 https://www.db.com/company/company.html

title: Senior Supply Chain Scheduling Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You On This Role**
 The Senior Supply Chain Improvement Specialist supports business growth, service enhancements and cost\-to\-serve productivity by identifying, designing and implementing supply chain and E2E value chain improvements. The role may focus deeply on a specific supply chain sub\-function or span multiple functions across the E2E value chain, depending on business priorities. This role delivers measurable business value through structured improvement methodologies, strong analytics and effective cross‑functional collaboration at local, regional and global levels.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**E2E Supply Chain Design and Optimization**
* Design, optimize and test supply chain and E2E network scenarios using analytical and optimization tools (e.g. OMP, spreadsheet analysis, simulation modeling).Drive adoption of ERP and internal supply planning platforms like OMP, DOC, MEIO etc.
* Own model assumptions, constraints and business rules \- ensure alignment with commercial, operational and financial objectives.
* Identify and balance trade\-offs across inventory, sourcing, production, logistics, service levels, capital investment and asset utilization.
* Support or lead supply chain infrastructure design and optimization (distribution networks, warehouses, plants, outsourcing models, logistics assets such as tanks and warehouses).


**Cost\-to\-Serve, Productivity \& Value Creation**
* Identify, lead and deliver cost\-to\-serve, productivity and service improvement initiatives across the E2E value chain.
* Drive measurable improvements in supply chain costs, cash flow, asset utilization, productivity, quality and customer service.
* Take ownership of improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and value realization.


**Analytics, Metrics \& Storytelling**
* Deep dive into assigned supply chain disciplines to build strong conceptual, process and data understanding.
* Develop, analyze and track meaningful metrics and KPIs to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Use analytical techniques to generate insights and recommendations.
* Translate complex analyses into clear, compelling business storytelling to influence cross‑functional stakeholders and drive prioritization.


**Ways of Working \& Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with business teams, regional/global partners and other E2E Improvement Specialists to ensure alignment and leverage synergies.
* Provide informal guidance and coaching to junior team members and interns.
* Interact with Quality, SMEs and customer\-facing teams to address service gaps, complaints and customer requirements.


**Qualifications**
* 3–8 years of experience in Supply Chain, Operations or related process improvement roles.
* University degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* APICS and/or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Experience with SAP and familiarity with analytics/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Python) preferred.


**Your Skills**
* Supply chain network optimization and E2E process understanding
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and modeling skills
* Project and change management capability
* Ability to influence without authority and collaborate across functions and regions
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on value creation
* Strong communication and data storytelling skills
* Appetite for digital enablement and productivity improvements


**Additional Notes**
* Role may require flexibility to work across different time zones.
* Scope may evolve based on organizational priorities and project allocation.
* Relocation or visa sponsorship is not aligned with this role


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.

+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
